name: CAT'S ARREST 2
source:
Hitomi and Ai managed to escape from the naughty hell owing to Rui.
However, their hide-out wasn't a safe place either. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE055457.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
在泪的帮助下，瞳与爱总算逃出了那座淫虐地狱。
然而，她们的藏身之处也并不安全。

（摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE055457.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]）
